Witchmark of Strength.Description: Channels dark might into both steel and sorcery.
Witchmark of Strength.Lore: A witch-marked pebble, prison for dark blessings. A faintly glowing sigil reveals its purpose.

Witchmark of Plentitude.Description: Warps Fortune's hand to provide in times of need.
Witchmark of Plentitude.Lore: A witch-marked pebble, prison for dark blessings. A faintly glowing sigil reveals its purpose.
Witchmark of Plentitude.Trivia: Random ground spawn on Witch Mountain

Witchmark of Resiliency.Description: Dulls the bite of enemy attacks.
Witchmark of Resiliency.Lore: A witch-marked pebble, prison for dark blessings. A faintly glowing sigil reveals its purpose.

Witchmark of Endurance.Lore: A witch-marked pebble, prison for dark blessings. A faintly glowing sigil reveals its purpose.

Supply Chest Key.Description: Unlocks the [[supply chests]] the preyers carried out of the capitana.
Supply Chest Key.Lore: A mischievous device, unable to open any lock when used by a mortal.

Shard of the Mask of Cain.Description: Forged in battle, a small piece of the preyer's mask.
Shard of the Mask of Cain.Lore: Like a cursed gold coin, mesmerizing but unpleasant to touch.

Shard of the Mask of Elias.Description: Forged in battle, a small piece of the preyer's mask.
Shard of the Mask of Elias.Lore: Made of silver, to celebrate the godhood of Judas Iscariot.

Shard of the Mask of Goliath.Description: Forged in battle, a small piece of the preyer's mask.
Shard of the Mask of Goliath.Lore: Emits a faint echo of a demonic scream.

Shadow Orb.Description: Description varies from Shadow Orb to Shadow Orb.
Shadow Orb.Lore: The mysterious orb offers a challenge that requires elimination of  Witch's minions, foraging or scavanging in various locations or with specific methods.
Shadow Orb.Trivia: Dropped by Major enemies. Only one may be active at a time.

Angelica.Lore: Some claim it was the Archangel Gabriel, others swear by Raphael, but it was most likely Michael who visited the botanist monk and revealed the herb to him.
Angelica.Trivia: Found in world as a green tall flower.

Corpse Wax.Description: A waxy substance harvested from the dead.
Corpse Wax.Lore: Unlike natural corpse wax that forms in deep graves, this substance appears instantly when a witch's puppet dies, still warm to the touch.

Eryngium.Lore: Executioners planted them around gallows, claiming the flowers would turn blood-red before a wrongful death.
Eryngium.Trivia: Found in world as a blue tall flower.

Blackened Salt.Description: Salt crystals stained by dark magic.
Blackened Salt.Lore: Blessed salt meant to ward off evil, now turned black, corrupted by the very power it should repel.

Maiden's Hair.Lore: A first cut lock offered by young maidens to priests as a symbol of their innocence.

Blood Lily.Description: A flower with an unexpectedly unpleasant smell.
Blood Lily.Lore: Some say these flowers bloom from the witch's own footprints, marking each spot where she worked her cruelty.
Blood Lily.Trivia: Found in world as a small red flower.

Charred Bone.Lore: When spells claim a life, they leave their mark, staining bones with hues no natural fire could ever create.
Charred Bone.Trivia: Found when enemies are killed by spells.

Moonflower.Lore: Witches discovered these blossoms can store moonlight like vessels hold water, later using it to heal wounds caused by dark magic.
Moonflower.Trivia: Found in world as a flower on walls.

Cross.Description: The symbol of punishment for those who defy the Church. Will be converted into [[Gold]].
Cross.Lore: A sad reminder that any witch's ghoul was once a person. With the owner dead, now just a valuable for sale.

Gemstones.Description: Kept for a gift or the dark hour, used for neither. Will be converted into [[Gold]].
Gemstones.Lore: A sad reminder that any witch's ghoul was once a person. With the owner dead, now just a valuable for sale.
